route_file_rest_import_allowlist.allowed_usage: Blossom server health/list/blob HTTP surfaces only; registry artifacts remain Nostr read-model backed.
SBOM and attestation HTTP surfaces only; artifact read model and signature verification remain separate Nostr/encrypted flows.

entries.surface: Dashboard `/` and shared dashboard stores
evidence: Shared dashboard loaders call bootstrapControlplane().
Read-model bootstrap subscribes to scoped filters, tracks EOSE, and keeps subscriptions open for realtime updates.

entries.surface: `/orgs/**` browser organization operations
evidence: Org store sends encrypted request/result operations such as orgs.list, orgs.create, and orgs.delete with the orgs domain tag.
Backend encrypted domain handlers adapt repository-backed organization CRUD/membership/invite operations to encrypted 5980/7980 request/result events without public org read-model projection.
docs/control-planes.md and docs/user-guide/features/organizations.md classify orgs as an encrypted request/result facade, not nostr_native read models.

entries.surface: `/payments` private payment history
evidence: Payment store uses encrypted requestEncryptedResult() for payments.history.
Backend encrypted handler calls the payment service and returns an encrypted correlated result.

entries.surface: `/notifications/**` channel config, tests, and logs
evidence: Notification stores send encrypted request/result operations for channels and logs.
Delivery may target Nostr DMs, but CRUD/log transport is encrypted request/result.

entries.surface: `/services/**` current web route read models and public commands
evidence: Service list/detail pages use relay-backed stores and public control-plane command helpers.
REST service endpoints remain compatibility surfaces outside current signer-first route command ingress.

entries.surface: `/environments/**` route read models and public commands
evidence: Environment routes read via Nostr stores and create/update/delete through encrypted ContextVM kind 25910 command helpers with OK/result/projection trace coverage in web/tests/e2e/environments-crud-smoke.spec.js.
Detail route waits for explicit Nostr result events for worker policy changes and hydrates environment/state/history rows from canonical 30900 read models.

entries.surface: `/deployments/**` route read models, commands, and private log snapshots
evidence: Deployment routes use Nostr stores and public-controlplane actions.
Run logs are presented as public relay projection plus encrypted Nostr request/result fetch.

entries.surface: `/artifacts/**` registry artifacts and Nostr signature verification
evidence: Artifact registry data is loaded from Nostr-backed stores.
Artifact signature verification uses encrypted Nostr verification UI/store paths.

entries.surface: Artifact Blossom controls and SBOM/attestation details
evidence: Blossom list/server/health calls use HTTP endpoints, which is expected for Blossom storage surfaces.
Artifact detail SBOM and attestation calls use REST API client methods.

entries.surface: `/packages/**` package read models and promote/yank commands
evidence: Package loaders use Nostr-backed stores.
Detail actions use public control-plane Nostr command helpers.

entries.surface: `/policies/**` current route read models and commands
evidence: Policy routes import Nostr stores and public-controlplane policy commands.
REST policy routes remain mounted as compatibility surfaces.

entries.surface: `/workers/**` worker ads, status, and control commands
evidence: Worker pages load worker Nostr stores and publish Nostr commands.
REST worker reads remain compatibility/catalog endpoints outside current route command ingress.

entries.surface: `/fleet-health` worker pressure and cleanup orchestration dashboard
evidence: Fleet Health reads worker, assignment, telemetry, and cleanup execution projections from shared Nostr-backed stores.
Cleanup actions are delegated to the worker cleanup request dialog rather than a route-level REST mutation.

entries.surface: `/ml` import and deployment browser submissions
evidence: ML page publishes import/deploy operations through publishCommand() using ml/model-import and ml/inference-deploy ContextVM Nostr commands.
Backend reactor handles those ContextVM operations as ML Nostr requests and returns correlated ContextVM result events while ML registry projections update read models.
web/src/lib/api/client.js no longer exposes ML REST bridge methods or ML REST read-model facades.

entries.surface: `/ml` existing endpoint worker pin command
evidence: Existing endpoint pinning in web/src/routes/ml/+page.svelte calls publishCommand() with workload.pin.request before deployment submission when a pinned worker targets an existing endpoint.
The pin command follows signer-first browser Nostr request/result lifecycle semantics and shares the ML page's Nostr-native command ingress.

entries.surface: `/llm` route read models and operational mutations
evidence: LLM page imports public-controlplane actions and requester/kind helpers.
Backend still has registry REST reads, but deprecated operational REST mutations are not mounted in favor of signer-first Nostr kinds.

entries.surface: `/dns` and FIPS DNS mesh
evidence: DNS store uses scoped Nostr read-model subscriptions with onEvent, onEose, onClosed, and onAuth callbacks.
DNS command helper publishes signed requests and awaits explicit Bahia result events.

entries.surface: `/backup/**` read models and public commands
evidence: Backup routes call relay-backed stores and public-controlplane actions for probe/approve/reject flows.

entries.surface: `/continuity` status, topology, and simulation
evidence: Continuity load calls loadContinuityDashboardFromNostr() and consumes scoped relay filters for kind 30351/30353 status plus 31400-31404 definitions and 30315 continuity heartbeat events.
SimulationPanel derives worker-failure impact locally from the same Nostr event set instead of POSTing to a REST simulation endpoint.
internal/api/router/router.go no longer mounts /api/continuity/status, /api/continuity/topology, or /api/continuity/simulate.

entries.surface: `/souls/**` Soul Factory pages
evidence: Soul routes use Nostr client/store helpers and direct subscriptions.
Partial EOSE fallback and progress subscription gaps are tracked separately.

entries.surface: `/events` relay activity route
evidence: Events route imports event/read-model stores and labels relay connection state.

entries.surface: `/settings` discovery and local relay/signer configuration
evidence: Settings manipulates Nostr client relay configuration and Nostr Connect auth.
System discovery/bootstrap may be HTTP-native and is not treated as fake Nostr control-plane command ingress.

entries.surface: `/settings/profile` signer-backed Nostr profile metadata publishing
evidence: Profile settings builds standard kind-0 metadata events, signs through the active NIP-07 or NIP-46 auth signer flow, and publishes to writable signer/NIP-65 relays.
publishProfileMetadata() checks per-relay OK outcomes and requires at least one accepted=true relay before updating cached profile state.

entries.surface: `/settings/relays` operator relay policy, relay administration, and local browser relay reconnect controls
evidence: `/settings/relays` renders RelaySettingsPanel, which applies persistent relay policy and relay-admin operations through requestEncryptedResult() ContextVM operations settings/relay-policy.apply and settings/relay-admin.call.

RelaySettingsPanel subscribes to canonical 30900 relay-settings state via subscribeRelayPolicyReadModel() with #d/domain/schema filters plus EOSE/CLOSED/AUTH callbacks; local browser relay add/remove/reconnect remains client-local Nostr relay configuration.

entries.surface: `/docs` and `/docs/[topic]` central documentation browser reads via NIP-23
evidence: Docs pages query kind 30023 (NIP-23 long-form content) events tagged with bahia-docs from the relay via queryOrPartial().
Backend NostrDocsPublisher syncs docs/user-guide/ Markdown to relay as addressable NIP-23 events on startup with content-hash change detection.
No REST API import or /api/v1/docs fetch remains in the docs route files.

entries.surface: Standalone relay sidecar HTTP/NIP-11/WebSocket server on `/` or configured `/relay` path
evidence: cmd/relay/main.go starts relaysidecar.New(...).Run(ctx) when nostr.sidecar.enabled is true.

internal/relaysidecar/server.go creates a net/http server and serves the Khatru relay for NIP-11 HTTP metadata plus Nostr WebSocket traffic on `/` and the path from nostr.sidecar.public_url such as `/relay`.
docs/investigations/rest-api-audit-2026-06-01.md classifies this surface as permanent Nostr relay infrastructure, not REST CRUD.

entries.surface: Mounted `/api/v1` compatibility endpoints for legacy/domain reads and writes
evidence: Router still mounts REST compatibility routes for legacy clients and domain reads/writes outside current browser command ingress.
web/src/lib/api/client.js intentionally omits redundant compatibility groups and keeps only HTTP-native Blossom/SBOM interop helpers used by web routes.
